title: add-rag-agent-playbooks-tool-calling-examples-and-docs-site-update
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Added RAG agent playbook templates, tool-calling examples (Python + TypeScript), and updated docs site quickstarts and sidebar. No breaking changes.
body: Summary: This PR adds a set of opinionated RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent playbooks and tool-calling examples meant to help engineers onboard quickly. It contains: 1) RAG agent templates (playbooks) that show common retrieval+agent flows (single-doc retrieval, multi-doc fusion, and stepwise tool-calling), 2) concrete examples demonstrating tool-calling with an HTTP search tool and a local file-reader tool (Python + TypeScript), 3) docs site quickstarts and sidebar updates to surface the new examples under "Quickstarts > Agents & RAG", and 4) small fixes to the examples CI and docs build config.
commits: a1f3d2b: feat(rag): add base RAG agent playbook templates and README
b4c7e9a: feat(examples): python example demonstrating tool-calling + plugins
c8b2f11: feat(examples): typescript agent example with HTTP-search tool
d3e9a77: docs(site): add quickstart pages and update sidebar
e6f12b4: ci: fix docs build step and add smoke test for examples
review_comments: Evan Park: Nice set of examples - can you add a short security note about untrusted tool output? Suggest adding a section in the playbook about sanitizing and validating tool responses.
Priya Nair: Thanks Evan - added a 'Security considerations' subsection to each playbook and a short note in the README. Also added an optional reject/validate step for tools in the Python example.
Marta Ruiz: Docs look good. One small ask - update the sidebar group label for clarity and ensure the quickstart has a single command to run the python example locally.
Priya Nair: Sidebar label updated to 'Agents & RAG' and added run script and single-command quickstart (python -m examples.agents.tool_calling_example).
Kofi Mensah: CI failed on initial run because linting flagged a TS typing issue. Also can we add a smoke test to ensure the examples run in CI?
Priya Nair: Fixed TS type, added a lightweight examples smoke test (examples-smoke.yml) that runs the python and node quickstarts in a container with mock tools. All checks green after fixes.
ci_checks: ci/lint: success (lint failure fixed in second commit)
ci/e2e: skipped (examples smoke covers minimal validation)
notes: Motivation: many users ask for concrete agent playbooks and tool-calling examples when evaluating Redwood for RAG use cases. These templates reduce onboarding time and give benchmarks for cost/latency tradeoffs.
Testing: added an examples smoke CI job that runs minimal end-to-end checks using a local mock HTTP search tool and a file-backed retriever. Maintainers can opt out for heavy CI runs.
Docs: quickstart added at /docs/quickstarts/agents-rag and the sidebar updated so examples appear under 'Quickstarts > Agents & RAG'.
Backward compatibility: examples are additive and documented; no runtime or API breaking changes to Redwood runtime or SDKs.
